title: Release train playbook: API + Console + Runtime gate process and launch coordination
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a single source-of-truth playbook and gate process for the combined API / Console / Runtime release train. Deliverables: milestone schedule, scope lock rules, cut criteria for features/bugfixes, release notes coordination plan, communication timeline for internal teams (engineers, docs, support, sales, marketing), and go-to-market task list with owners. This ticket acts as the PM-level orchestration artifact to drive cross-team alignment and sign-offs for the 2026-Q2 release bundle.
milestones: 2026-02-20: Draft playbook and initial milestone dates published
2026-03-05: Cross-team review (runtime, api, console, docs, marketing, sales)
2026-03-12: Scope lock decision meeting (finalize feature candidates for GA vs. post-launch)
2026-03-19: Cut criteria review and emergency rollback plan sign-off
2026-03-26: Release notes freeze (final content handed to docs & comms)
2026-03-29: Release readiness verification (SLOs, canary plan, post-launch runbook)
cut_criteria: Severity-based: Any P0 customer-facing regression introduced within two weeks of release -> block
Performance SLOs: 95th latency for standard text generation must be within agreed target or the feature is cut
Security/Compliance: Any unresolved security review items must be cut or gated behind private deployment only
Interoperability: Breaking API contract changes without migration plan -> cut
Test coverage: New feature must have automated integration tests and smoke tests in canary environment
Rollback cost: If a feature requires >2 engineer-hours per incident to revert in production, escalate for possible cut
release_notes_plan: Primary owner: Documentation (Marta Svensson) to maintain canonical RN draft in Confluence
Section breakdown: API changes, Console UX updates, Runtime performance/ops changes, Known issues/limitations, Upgrade notes
Style: One-page highlights for marketing, detailed changelog for engineering customers
Approval flow: Docs -> PM -> Eng lead -> Security (if applicable) -> Marketing
Localization: Identify high-impact customer regions by 2026-03-18 for translate requests

Sales: Prepare enablement deck and talk tracks for Enterprise (owner: Marco Ruiz)

Pricing/Finance: Validate any SKU or metering changes and billing test plan (owner: Henry Lopez)
Partner: Notify channel partners and marketplace teams about release timeline (owner: Partnerships)
Legal & Compliance: Confirm copy approvals and any regulatory notices

Security sign-off: Sasha Iverson (if any security_review_required items)

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Kernel-level performance regression discovered in late testing -> Mitigation: freeze experimental kernels for this train and schedule follow-up patch in runtime-1.23
Risk: Docs lag causes incorrect upgrade instructions -> Mitigation: parallel docs reviews with nightly syncs and a docs-only freeze two days before RN freeze
Risk: Feature scope creep across components -> Mitigation: enforce scope lock meeting and require a two-thirds approval to reopen scope
Risk: Canaries expose region-specific issues -> Mitigation: stagger canary rollouts by region and maintain hotfix playbook
